description: Starts or looks at an agent journey: the extension opens the start URL in a scratch tab and returns what an agent can see there, the page URL, title, visible text and the controls with a ref each, plus the WebMCP tools the page registers. Start with url and task; continue with journeyId after each journey_act. Use it to test whether an AI agent can complete a key task on the site. Needs the Chrome extension. Returns journeyId, the step count (a journey ends at 15 steps) and the observation.

journeyId.description: The journey to look at again, from an earlier journey_observe. Omit to start one.

task.description: What a customer's agent was asked to do, such as "find the price of the Pro plan". Required when journeyId is absent.

url.description: Where a new journey starts, usually the home page. Required when journeyId is absent.

name: journey_observe
title: Observe an agent journey
